card.name: Start of the word filibuster
card.fires_on: The first piece of the word filibuster ("filib") in Senate procedure articles, before the ending "uster". Rarely on other split-up words like plagiarise.

modes.label: filibuster in politics
modes.description: The opening piece of filibuster in discussion of Senate debate rules.
modes.example: Senate Majority Leader Harry Reid has finally called for ending the silent<< filib>>uster.

modes.label: other split words
modes.description: Occasional partway-through-word cases outside politics, such as plagiarise or capitalized warnings.
modes.example: You can lose marks or even face serious sanctions if you<< plagiar>>ise.
